duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā wa-tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī a'ūdhu bika an as'alaka mā laysa lī bihi 'ilmun wa-illā taghfir lī wa-tarḥamnī akun minal-khāsirīn
duas.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking You about that of which I have no knowledge. And if You do not forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa-liwālidayya wa-liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa-lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all believing men and women.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka antas-samī'ul-'alīm, wa-tub 'alaynā innaka antat-tawwābur-raḥīm
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. And accept our repentance. Indeed You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-j'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa-min dhurriyyatī, Rabbanā wa-taqabbal du'ā'
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā-ghfir lī wa-liwālidayya wa-lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa-alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa-j'al lī lisāna ṣidqin fil-ākhirīn, wa-j'alnī min warathati jannatin-na'īm, wa-ghfir li-abī innahū kāna minaḍ-ḍāllīn, wa-lā tukhzinī yawma yub'athūn
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous, and grant me a mention of honor among later generations, and place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure, and forgive my father — indeed he was among those who erred — and do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me a child from the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā 'alayka tawakkalnā wa-ilayka anabnā wa-ilaykal-maṣīr
duas.translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā fitnatan lilladhīna kafarū wa-ghfir lanā rabbanā innaka antal-'azīzul-ḥakīm
duas.translation: Our Lord, make us not a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us. Our Lord, indeed You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallatī an'amta 'alayya wa-'alā wālidayya wa-an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhilnī bi-raḥmatika fī 'ibādikash-ṣāliḥīn
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness of which You approve, and admit me by Your mercy into the ranks of Your righteous servants.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samī'ud-du'ā'
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi lā tadharni fardan wa-anta khayrul-wārithīn
duas.translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

duas.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn
duas.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa-yassir lī amrī wa-ḥlul 'uqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī
duas.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-ghfir lī
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattaba'nar-rasūla fak-tubnā ma'ash-shāhidīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā fitnatan lil-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn, wa-najjinā bi-raḥmatika minal-qawmil-kāfirīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, make us not a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa-isrāfanā fī amrinā wa-thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess in our affairs, and plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa-hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī 'ilmā
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'ūdhu bika min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa-a'ūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūn
duas.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir wa-rḥam wa-anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of those who show mercy.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa-fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa-qinā 'adhāban-nār
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Sami'nā wa-aṭa'nā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa-ilaykal-maṣīr
duas.translation: We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the destination.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā, Rabbanā wa-lā taḥmil 'alaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū 'alal-ladhīna min qablinā, Rabbanā wa-lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, wa-'fu 'annā wa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā, anta mawlānā fa-nṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā ba'da idh hadaytanā wa-hab lanā min ladunka raḥmatan innaka antal-wahhāb
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan subḥānaka faqinā 'adhāban-nār, Rabbanā innaka man tudkhilin-nāra faqad akhzaytahū wa-mā liẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār, Rabbanā innanā sami'nā munādiyan yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū birabbikum fa-āmannā, Rabbanā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa-kaffir 'annā sayyi'ātinā wa-tawaffanā ma'al-abrār, Rabbanā wa-ātinā mā wa'adtanā 'alā rusulika wa-lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmati innaka lā tukhliful-mī'ād
duas.translation: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You above such a thing; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire — You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā wa-anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā-ṣrif 'annā 'adhāba jahannam, inna 'adhābahā kāna gharamā, innahā sā'at mustaqarran wa-muqāmā
duas.translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa-dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin wa-j'alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallatī an'amta 'alayya wa-'alā wālidayya wa-an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tubtu ilayka wa-innī minal-muslimīn
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā wa-li-ikhwāninadh-dhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān wa-lā taj'al fī qulūbinā ghillan lilladhīna āmanū, Rabbanā innaka Ra'ūfun Raḥīm
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-ghfir lanā innaka 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
duas.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā innanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa-qinā 'adhāban-nār
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ktubnā ma'ash-shāhidīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-j'al hādhal-balada āminan wa-jnubnī wa-baniyya an na'budal-aṣnām
duas.translation: My Lord, make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-nṣurnī 'alal-qawmil-mufsidīn
duas.translation: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā ma'al-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbul-'arshil-'aẓīm
duas.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

duas.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
duas.transliteration: 'Asā rabbī an yahdiyani sawā'as-sabīl
duas.translation: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound path.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjinī minal-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn
duas.translation: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa-fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa-qinā 'adhāban-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ قَلْبِي بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِن الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِن الدَّنَسِ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min fitnatinnār wa-'adhābin-nār, wa-fitnatil-qabr wa-'adhābil-qabr, wa-sharri fitnatil-ghinā, wa-sharri fitnatil-faqr, Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min sharri fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl. Allāhumma-ghsil qalbī bi-mā'ith-thalji wal-barad, wa-naqqi qalbī minal-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta-th-thawbal-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa-bā'id baynī wa-bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bā'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-kasali wal-ma'thami wal-maghram
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the Fire and the punishment of the Fire, and the trial of the grave and the punishment of the grave, and the evil of the trial of wealth, and the evil of the trial of poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah. O Allah, cleanse my heart with the water of snow and hail, and purify my heart from sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth, and distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness, sin, and debt.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَالْهَرَمِ، وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubn, wal-haram, wal-bukhl, wa-a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābil-qabr, wa-min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāt
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, senility, and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave and from the trial of life and death.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min jahdil-balā', wa-darakish-shaqā', wa-sū'il-qaḍā', wa-shamātatil-a'dā'
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the severity of tribulation, from misery overtaking, from an evil fate, and from the gloating of enemies.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِن كُلِّ شَرٍّ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīniyadh-dhī huwa 'iṣmatu amrī, wa-aṣliḥ lī dunyāyal-latī fīhā ma'āshī, wa-aṣliḥ lī ākhiratiyallatī fīhā ma'ādī, wa-j'alil-ḥayāta ziyādatan lī fī kulli khayr, wa-j'alil-mawta rāḥatan lī min kulli sharr
duas.translation: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, and set right for me my world in which is my livelihood, and set right for me my Hereafter to which is my return, and make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā, wat-tuqā, wal-'afāf, wal-ghinā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ، وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَالْهَرَمِ، وَالْبُخْلِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا، وَزَكِّهَا أَنتَ خَيْرُ مَن زَكَّاهَا، أَنتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنفَعُ، وَمِن قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِن نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِن دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi, wal-kasal, wal-jubn, wal-haram, wal-bukhl, wa-'adhābil-qabr. Allāhumma āti nafsī taqwāhā, wa-zakkihā anta khayru man zakkāhā, anta waliyyuhā wa-mawlāhā, Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa', wa-min qalbin lā yakhsha', wa-min nafsin lā tashba', wa-min da'watin lā yustajābu lahā
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, senility, miserliness, and the punishment of the grave. O Allah, grant my soul its piety, and purify it — You are the best of those who purify it, You are its Guardian and Master. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالسَّدَادَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-hdinī wa-saddidnī. Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā was-sadād
duas.translation: O Allah, guide me and make me upright. O Allah, I ask You for guidance and uprightness.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min zawāli ni'matik, wa-taḥawwuli 'āfiyatik, wa-fujā'ati niqmatik, wa-jamī'i sakhaṭik
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the disappearance of Your blessing, from the change of Your protection, from the sudden onset of Your punishment, and from all Your wrath.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ، وَمِن شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā 'amiltu, wa-min sharri mā lam a'mal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done, and from the evil of what I have not yet done.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي، وَوَلَدِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي، وَأَطِلْ حَيَاتِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ، وَأَحْسِنْ عَمَلِي، وَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma akthir mālī wa-waladī, wa-bārik lī fīmā a'ṭaytanī, wa-aṭil ḥayātī 'alā ṭā'atik, wa-aḥsin 'amalī, wa-ghfir lī
duas.translation: O Allah, increase my wealth and children, and bless me in what You have given me, and prolong my life in Your obedience, and make my deeds good, and forgive me.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhul-'aẓīmul-ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbul-'arshil-'aẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbus-samāwāt wa-rabbul-arḍ wa-rabbul-'arshil-karīm
duas.translation: There is no deity except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū fa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'ayn, wa-aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullahū lā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no deity except You.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn
duas.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِندَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī 'abduka bnu 'abdika bnu amatik, nāṣiyatī bi-yadik, māḍin fiyya ḥukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qaḍā'uk, as'aluka bi-kulli-smin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahū fī kitābik, aw 'allamtahū aḥadan min khalqik, awi-sta'tharta bihi fī 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an taj'alal-Qur'āna rabī'a qalbī, wa-nūra ṣadrī, wa-jalā'a ḥuznī, wa-dhahāba hammī
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name You have named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen — that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sadness, and the relief of my distress.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma muṣarrifal-qulūb ṣarrif qulūbanā 'alā ṭā'atik
duas.translation: O Allah, Turner of hearts, turn our hearts toward Your obedience.

duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Yā muqallibal-qulūb thabbit qalbī 'alā dīnik
duas.translation: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْيَقِينَ وَالْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-yaqīna wal-'afwa wal-'āfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for certainty, pardon, and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aḥsin 'āqibatanā fil-umūri kullihā, wa-ajirnā min khizyid-dunyā wa-'adhābil-ākhirah
duas.translation: O Allah, make our outcome good in all matters, and save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ، وَانصُرْنِي وَلَا تَنصُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَامْكُرْ لِي وَلَا تَمْكُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرِ الْهُدَى إِلَيَّ، وَانصُرْنِي عَلَى مَن بَغَى عَلَيَّ، رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي لَكَ شَكَّارًا، لَكَ ذَكَّارًا، لَكَ رَهَّابًا، لَكَ مِطْوَاعًا، إِلَيْكَ مُخْبِتًا أَوَّاهًا مُنِيبًا، رَبِّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتِي، وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتِي، وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي، وَثَبِّتْ حُجَّتِي، وَاهْدِ قَلْبِي، وَسَدِّدْ لِسَانِي، وَاسْلُلْ سَخِيمَةَ قَلْبِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'innī wa-lā tu'in 'alayy, wa-nṣurnī wa-lā tanṣur 'alayy, wa-mkur lī wa-lā tamkur 'alayy, wa-hdinī wa-yassir al-hudā ilayy, wa-nṣurnī 'alā man baghā 'alayy, Rabbi-j'alnī laka shakkāran, laka dhakkāran, laka rahhāban, laka miṭwā'an, ilayka mukhbitan awwāhan munīban, Rabbi taqabbal tawbatī, wa-ghsil ḥawbatī, wa-ajib da'watī, wa-thabbit ḥujjatī, wa-hdi qalbī, wa-saddid lisānī, wa-slul sakhīmata qalbī
duas.translation: My Lord, help me and do not help anyone against me, grant me victory and do not grant victory over me, plot for me and do not plot against me, guide me and make guidance easy for me, and give me victory over those who wrong me. My Lord, make me greatly thankful to You, greatly remembering of You, greatly fearful of You, greatly obedient to You, humble toward You, lamenting and repentant. My Lord, accept my repentance, wash away my sin, answer my supplication, establish my proof, guide my heart, straighten my tongue, and remove the malice from my heart.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِن خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَنتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ، وَعَلَيكَ الْبَلَاغُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innā nas'aluka min khayri mā sa'alaka minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam, wa-na'ūdhu bika min sharri ma-sta'ādha minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam, wa-antal-musta'ān, wa-'alaykal-balāgh, wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā billāh
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You for the best of what Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for, and we seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sought refuge. You are the One from Whom help is sought, and upon You is the conveyance, and there is no power or strength except through Allah.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ سَمْعِي، وَمِن شَرِّ بَصَرِي، وَمِن شَرِّ لِسَانِي، وَمِن شَرِّ قَلْبِي، وَمِن شَرِّ مَنِيِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min sharri sam'ī, wa-min sharri baṣarī, wa-min sharri lisānī, wa-min sharri qalbī, wa-min sharri maniyyī
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing, the evil of my sight, the evil of my tongue, the evil of my heart, and the evil of my desires.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِن سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-baraṣ, wal-junūn, wal-judhām, wa-min sayyi'il-asqām
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, elephantiasis, and evil diseases.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن مُنكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، وَالْأَعْمَالِ، وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min munkarātil-akhlāq, wal-a'māl, wal-ahwā'
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil deeds, and evil desires.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun karīmun tuḥibbul-'afwa fa-'fu 'annī
duas.translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, Generous; You love to pardon, so pardon me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَن تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدتَّ فِتْنَةَ قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَن يُحِبُّكَ، وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka fi'lal-khayrāt, wa-tarkal-munkarāt, wa-ḥubbal-masākīn, wa-an taghfira lī wa-tarḥamanī, wa-idhā aradta fitnat qawmin fa-tawaffanī ghayra maftūn, wa-as'aluka ḥubbak, wa-ḥubba man yuḥibbuk, wa-ḥubba 'amalin yuqarribunī ilā ḥubbik
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the ability to do good deeds, to abandon evil, to love the poor, and that You forgive me and have mercy on me. And if You intend to put a people to trial, then take me without being put to trial. I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of deeds that bring me closer to Your love.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ بِكَ مِنْهُ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِن قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِن قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَن تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka minal-khayri kullih: 'ājilihī wa-ājilih, mā 'alimtu minhu wa-mā lam a'lam, wa-a'ūdhu bika minash-sharri kullih 'ājilihī wa-ājilih, mā 'alimtu minhu wa-mā lam a'lam. Allāhumma innī as'aluka min khayri mā sa'alaka 'abduka wa-nabiyyuk, wa-a'ūdhu bika min sharri ma-sta'ādha bika 'abduka wa-nabiyyuk. Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa-mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amal, wa-a'ūdhu bika minan-nāri wa-mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amal, wa-as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qaḍā'in qaḍaytahū lī khayrā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all good — its immediate and its delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil — its immediate and its delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your servant and Prophet asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings me close to it of speech or deed, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings me close to it of speech or deed, and I ask You to make every decree You have decreed for me a good one.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا، وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوًّا وَلَا حَاسِدًا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن كُلِّ شَرٍّ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi qā'imā, wa-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi qā'idā, wa-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi rāqidā, wa-lā tushmit bī 'aduwwan wa-lā ḥāsidā. Allāhumma innī as'aluka min kulli khayrin khazā'inuhū bi-yadik, wa-a'ūdhu bika min kulli sharrin khazā'inuhū bi-yadik
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me through Islam while standing, and protect me through Islam while sitting, and protect me through Islam while lying down. And do not let an enemy or envier gloat over me. O Allah, I ask You for every good whose treasuries are in Your hand, and I seek refuge in You from every evil whose treasuries are in Your hand.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِن خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِن طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُوَّاتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَن ظَلَمَنَا، وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى مَن عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَن لَا يَرْحَمُنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-qsim lanā min khashyatika mā yaḥūlu baynanā wa-bayna ma'āṣīk, wa-min ṭā'atika mā tuballighunā bihi jannatak, wa-minal-yaqīni mā tuhawwinu bihi 'alaynā maṣā'ibad-dunyā. Allāhumma matti'nā bi-asmā'inā wa-abṣārinā wa-quwwātinā mā aḥyaytanā, wa-j'alhu-l-wāritha minnā, wa-j'al tha'ranā 'alā man ẓalamanā, wa-nṣurnā 'alā man 'ādānā, wa-lā taj'al muṣībatanā fī dīninā, wa-lā taj'alid-dunyā akbara hamminā, wa-lā mablagha 'ilminā, wa-lā tusalliq 'alaynā man lā yarḥamunā
duas.translation: O Allah, apportion for us from Your fear what will stand between us and Your disobedience, and from Your obedience what will bring us to Your Paradise, and from certainty what will make the calamities of this world easy upon us. O Allah, let us enjoy our hearing, sight, and strength for as long as You keep us alive, and make these our heirs. Grant us vengeance against those who wrong us, and help us against those who oppose us. Do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world our greatest concern or the limit of our knowledge, and do not empower over us those who have no mercy on us.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن أَن أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-jubn, wa-a'ūdhu bika minal-bukhl, wa-a'ūdhu bika min an uradda ilā ardhalil-'umur, wa-a'ūdhu bika min fitnatid-dunyā wa-'adhābil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most feeble stage of life, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world and the punishment of the grave.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي، وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي هَزْلِي، وَجِدِّي، وَخَطَئِي، وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī khaṭī'atī wa-jahlī wa-isrāfī fī amrī wa-mā anta a'lamu bihi minnī, Allāhumma-ghfir lī hazlī wa-jiddī wa-khaṭa'ī wa-'amdī wa-kullu dhālika 'indī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me my sin, my ignorance, my excess in my affairs, and what You know better than I about myself. O Allah, forgive me my jest and my seriousness, my mistakes and my intentional sins — all of that is with me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنتَ. فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِن عِندِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīrā, wa-lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant. Fa-ghfir lī maghfiratan min 'indik, wa-rḥamnī innaka antal-Ghafūrur-Raḥīm
duas.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins except You. So grant me forgiveness from Yourself, and have mercy upon me. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ أَن تُضِلَّنِي، أَنتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنسُ يَمُوتُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka aslamtu wa-bika āmantu wa-'alayka tawakkaltu wa-ilayka anabtu wa-bika khāṣamtu. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bi-'izzatika lā ilāha illā anta an tuḍillanī, antal-ḥayyulladhī lā yamūt, wal-jinnu wal-insu yamūtūn
duas.translation: O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have turned, and by You I have disputed. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might — there is no deity except You — from being led astray. You are the Ever-Living Who does not die, while jinn and humans die.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِن كُلِّ إِثْمٍ، وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِن كُلِّ بِرٍّ، وَالْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ، وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innā nas'aluka mūjibāti raḥmatik, wa-'azā'ima maghfiratik, was-salāmata min kulli ithm, wal-ghanīmata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannah, wan-najāta minan-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You for the causes of Your mercy, and the means of Your forgiveness, and safety from every sin, and gain from every righteousness, and success in entering Paradise, and salvation from the Fire.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive the believing men and the believing women.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhanbī, wa-wassi' lī fī dārī, wa-bārik lī fīmā razaqtanī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me my sin, expand for me my home, and bless me in what You have provided me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِن فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlika wa-raḥmatik, fa-innahū lā yamliku-hā illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty and mercy, for none possesses them except You.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ، وَالتَّرَدِّي، وَالْهَدْمِ، وَالْغَمِّ، وَالْغَرَقِ، وَالْحَرَقِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَن يَتَخَبَّطَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ عِندَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَن أَمُوتَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِرًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَن أَمُوتَ لَدِيغًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-haram, wat-taraddī, wal-hadm, wal-ghamm, wal-gharaq, wal-ḥaraq, wa-a'ūdhu bika an yataKhabbaṭaniyash-shayṭānu 'indal-mawt, wa-a'ūdhu bika an amūta fī sabīlika mudbiran, wa-a'ūdhu bika an amūta ladīghā
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from extreme old age, from falling to death, from being crushed, from grief, from drowning, from burning, and I seek refuge in You from the devil seizing me at the time of death, and I seek refuge in You from dying while retreating in Your cause, and I seek refuge in You from dying by a venomous sting.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-jū', fa-innahū bi'sad-ḍajī', wa-a'ūdhu bika minal-khiyānah, fa-innahā bi'satil-biṭānah
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is a terrible bedfellow, and I seek refuge in You from treachery, for it is a terrible inner quality.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ، وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَالْبُخْلِ، وَالْهَرَمِ، وَالْقَسْوَةِ، وَالْغَفْلَةِ، وَالْعَيْلَةِ، وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَالْمَسْكَنَةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْكُفْرِ، وَالْفُسُوقِ، وَالشِّقَاقِ، وَالنِّفَاقِ، وَالسُّمْعَةِ، وَالرِّيَاءِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الصَّمَمِ، وَالْبَكَمِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَالْبَرَصِ، وَسَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi, wal-kasal, wal-jubn, wal-bukhl, wal-haram, wal-qaswah, wal-ghaflah, wal-'aylah, wadh-dhillah, wal-maskanah, wa-a'ūdhu bika minal-faqr, wal-kufr, wal-fusūq, wash-shiqāq, wan-nifāq, was-sum'ah, war-riyā', wa-a'ūdhu bika minaṣ-ṣamam, wal-bakam, wal-junūn, wal-judhām, wal-baraṣ, wa-sayyi'il-asqām
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, extreme old age, hard-heartedness, heedlessness, poverty, humiliation, and destitution. And I seek refuge in You from poverty, disbelief, wickedness, discord, hypocrisy, seeking fame, and showing off. And I seek refuge in You from deafness, muteness, madness, elephantiasis, leprosy, and evil diseases.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْفَاقَةِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن أَن أَظْلِمَ أَو أُظْلَمَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-faqr, wal-qillah, wadh-dhillah, wa-a'ūdhu bika min an aẓlima aw uẓlam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You from wronging others or being wronged.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ؛ فَإِنَّ جَارَ الْبَادِيَةِ يَتَحَوَّلُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min jāris-sū'i fī dāril-muqāmah, fa-inna jāral-bādiyati yataḥawwal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil neighbor in a permanent home, for the neighbor in the desert moves away.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِن دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ، وَمِن نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِن عِلْمٍ لَا يَنفَعُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَرْبَعِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min qalbin lā yakhsha', wa-min du'ā'in lā yusma', wa-min nafsin lā tashba', wa-min 'ilmin lā yanfa'. A'ūdhu bika min hā'ulā'il-arba'
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not humble itself, from a supplication that is not heard, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from knowledge that does not benefit. I seek refuge in You from these four.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن يَوْمِ السُّوءِ، وَمِن لَيْلَةِ السُّوءِ، وَمِن سَاعَةِ السُّوءِ، وَمِن صَاحِبِ السُّوءِ، وَمِن جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min yawmis-sū', wa-min laylatis-sū', wa-min sā'atis-sū', wa-min ṣāḥibis-sū', wa-min jāris-sū'i fī dāril-muqāmah
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil day, from an evil night, from an evil hour, from an evil companion, and from an evil neighbor in a permanent home.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa-astajīru bika minan-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek Your protection from the Fire.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْنِي فِي الدِّينِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma faqqihnī fid-dīn
duas.translation: O Allah, give me understanding in the religion.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَن أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa-anā a'lam, wa-astaghfiruka limā lā a'lam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating partners with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-nfa'nī bimā 'allamtanī, wa-'allimni mā yanfa'unī, wa-zidnī 'ilmā
duas.translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'ā, wa-rizqan ṭayyibā, wa-'amalan mutaqabbalā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and accepted deeds.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ، أَن تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka yā Allāhu bi-annaka al-Wāḥidul-Aḥadus-Ṣamadulladhī lam yalid wa-lam yūlad wa-lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad, an taghfira lī dhunūbī innaka antal-Ghafūrur-Raḥīm
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by Your being the One, the Unique, the Eternal Refuge, Who neither begets nor was begotten, and to Whom none is equal — that You forgive me my sins. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ الْمَنَّانُ يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-anna lakal-ḥamda lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lakal-Mannān, yā Badī'as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yā Dhal-Jalāli wal-Ikrām, yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, innī as'alukal-jannata wa-a'ūdhu bika minan-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You — for indeed all praise is Yours, there is no deity except You alone, You have no partner, the Bestower of blessings — O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer — I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-annī ash-hadu annaka antalLāhu lā ilāha illā antal-Aḥadus-Ṣamadul-ladhī lam yalid wa-lam yūlad wa-lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You by my bearing witness that You are Allah, there is no deity except You, the One, the Eternal, Who neither begets nor was begotten, and to Whom none is equal.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa-tub 'alayy, innaka antat-Tawwābul-Ghafūr
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Forgiving.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ، وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ، أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنفُدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ، فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَّا بِزِينَةِ الْإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bi-'ilmikal-ghayb wa-qudratika 'alal-khalq, aḥyinī mā 'alimtal-ḥayāta khayran lī, wa-tawaffanī idhā 'alimtal-wafāta khayran lī. Allāhumma innī as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahādah, wa-as'aluka kalimatal-ḥaqqi fir-riḍā wal-ghaḍab, wa-as'alukal-qaṣda fil-ghinā wal-faqr, wa-as'aluka na'īman lā yanfud, wa-as'aluka qurrata 'aynin lā tanqaṭi', wa-as'alukar-riḍā ba'dal-qaḍā', wa-as'aluka bardal-'ayshi ba'dal-mawt, wa-as'aluka ladhdhatan-naẓari ilā wajhik, wash-shawqa ilā liqā'ik, fī ghayri ḍarrā'a muḍirrah wa-lā fitnatim muḍillah. Allāhumma zayyinnā bi-zīnatil-īmān, wa-j'alnā hudātan muhtadīn
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life is good for me, and take me when You know death is better for me. O Allah, I ask You for Your fear in secret and in public, for the word of truth in contentment and in anger, for moderation in wealth and poverty. I ask You for a blessing that does not run out, for an eye's delight that does not cease, for contentment after Your decree, for the coolness of life after death, for the pleasure of looking upon Your face, and for yearning to meet You — without harmful suffering or misguiding trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith, and make us guides who are themselves guided.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَن يَنفَعُنِي حُبُّهُ عِندَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ، اللَّهُمَّ مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغًا لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-rzuqnī ḥubbak, wa-ḥubba man yanfa'unī ḥubbuhū 'indak. Allāhumma mā razaqtanī mimmā uḥibbu fa-j'alhu quwwatan lī fīmā tuḥibb. Allāhumma mā zawayta 'annī mimmā uḥibbu fa-j'alhu farāghan lī fīmā tuḥibb
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me Your love, and the love of those whose love will benefit me with You. O Allah, whatever You have provided me of what I love — make it a strength for me in what You love. O Allah, whatever You have withheld from me of what I love — make it a freeing of my time for what You love.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْهَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṭahhirnī minadh-dhunūbi wal-khaṭāyā, Allāhumma naqqinī minhā kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas, Allāhumma ṭahhirnī bith-thalji wal-baradi wal-mā'il-bārid
duas.translation: O Allah, purify me from sins and faults. O Allah, cleanse me of them as a white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, purify me with snow, hail, and cold water.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَسُوءِ الْعُمُرِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الصَّدْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-bukhl, wal-jubn, wa-sū'il-'umur, wa-fitnatish-ṣadr, wa-'adhābil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, cowardice, a bad end to life, the trial of the chest, and the punishment of the grave.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيكَائِيلَ، وَرَبَّ إِسْرَافِيلَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن حَرِّ النَّارِ، وَمِن عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba Jibrā'īl wa-Mīkā'īl wa-rabba Isrāfīl, a'ūdhu bika min ḥarrin-nār wa-min 'adhābil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibreel, Mikaa'eel, and Israfeel, I seek refuge in You from the heat of the Fire and from the punishment of the grave.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي، وَأَعِذْنِي مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma alhimnī rushdī, wa-a'idhnī min sharri nafsī
duas.translation: O Allah, inspire me with my right guidance, and protect me from the evil of my own soul.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن عِلْمٍ لَا يَنفَعُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'ā, wa-a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa'
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, and I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى وَمُنزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwātis-sab'i wa-rabbal-arḍi wa-rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīm, rabbanā wa-rabba kulli shay', fāliqal-ḥabbi wan-nawā, wa-munzilat-tawrāti wal-injīli wal-furqān, a'ūdhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. Allāhumma antal-awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shay', wa-antal-ākhiru fa-laysa ba'daka shay', wa-antat-ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shay', wa-antal-bāṭinu fa-laysa dūnaka shay', iqḍi 'annad-dayna wa-aghninā minal-faqr
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion — I seek refuge in You from the evil of every thing whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You; You are the Hidden, so there is nothing beneath You. Settle our debt and free us from poverty.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُلُوبِنَا، وَأَزْوَاجِنَا، وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعَمِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا عَلَيْكَ، قَابِلِينَ لَهَا، وَأَتِمِّمْهَا عَلَيْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbinā, wa-aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā, wa-hdinā subulas-salām, wa-najjinā minaz-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr, wa-jannibnal-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wa-mā baṭan, wa-bārik lanā fī asmā'inā wa-abṣārinā wa-qulūbinā wa-azwājinā wa-dhurriyyātinā, wa-tub 'alaynā innaka antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm, wa-j'alnā shākirīna li-ni'amika muthnīna bihā 'alayk, qābilīna lahā, wa-atimmhā 'alaynā
duas.translation: O Allah, unite our hearts, rectify what is between us, guide us to the paths of peace, and bring us from darkness to light. Keep us away from all indecencies — apparent and hidden. Bless us in our hearing, sight, hearts, spouses, and offspring. Accept our repentance — indeed You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising You with them, accepting them, and complete them upon us.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ، وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ، وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ، وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ، وَثَبِّتْنِي، وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي، وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِي، وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلَاتِي، وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ وَخَوَاتِمَهُ وَجَوَامِعَهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَظَاهِرَهُ وَبَاطِنَهُ وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ آمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا آتِي وَخَيْرَ مَا أَفْعَلُ وَخَيْرَ مَا أَعْمَلُ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَطَنَ وَخَيْرَ مَا ظَهَرَ وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ آمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَن تَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتُحَصِّنَ فَرْجِي وَتُنَوِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ آمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَن تُبَارِكَ فِي نَفْسِي وَفِي سَمْعِي وَفِي بَصَرِي وَفِي رُوحِي وَفِي خَلْقِي وَفِي خُلُقِي وَفِي أَهْلِي وَفِي مَحْيَايَ وَفِي مَمَاتِي وَفِي عَمَلِي فَتَقَبَّلْ حَسَنَاتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ آمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayral-mas'alah, wa-khayrad-du'ā', wa-khayrannajāḥ, wa-khayral-'amal, wa-khayrath-thawāb, wa-khayr al-ḥayāh, wa-khayral-mamāt, wa-thabbitnī, wa-thaqqil mawāzīnī, wa-ḥaqqiq īmānī, wa-rfa' darajātī, wa-taqabbal ṣalātī, wa-ghfir khaṭī'atī, wa-as'aluddaarajātil-'ulā minal-jannah. Allāhumma innī as'aluka fawātilal-khayri wa-khawātimahū wa-jawāmi'ahū wa-awwalahū wa-ẓāhirahū wa-bāṭinahū wad-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannati āmīn. Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra mā ātī wa-khayra mā af'alu wa-khayra mā a'malu wa-khayra mā baṭana wa-khayra mā ẓahara wad-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannati āmīn. Allāhumma innī as'aluka an tarfa'a dhikrī wa-taḍa'a wizrī wa-tuṣliḥa amrī wa-tuṭahhira qalbī wa-tuḥaṣṣina farjī wa-tunawwira qalbī wa-taghfira lī dhanbī wa-as'aluddaarajātil-'ulā minal-jannati āmīn. Allāhumma innī as'aluka an tubāraka fī nafsī wa-fī sam'ī wa-fī baṣarī wa-fī rūḥī wa-fī khalqī wa-fī khuluqī wa-fī ahlī wa-fī maḥyāya wa-fī mamātī wa-fī 'amalī fa-taqabbal ḥasanātī wa-as'aluddaarajātil-'ulā minal-jannati āmīn
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of asking, the best of supplication, the best of success, the best of deeds, the best of reward, the best of life, and the best of death. Make me firm, make my scales heavy, realize my faith, raise my ranks, accept my prayer, and forgive my sin. I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise. O Allah, I ask You for all the openings of good and its endings and its entirety — its beginning, its apparent, and its hidden — and the highest ranks of Paradise. Ameen. O Allah, I ask You for the best of what I come to, the best of what I do, the best of what I work, the best of what is hidden, and the best of what is apparent — and the highest ranks of Paradise. Ameen. O Allah, I ask You to raise my mention, remove my burden, set right my affairs, purify my heart, guard my chastity, illuminate my heart, and forgive my sin — and I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise. Ameen. O Allah, I ask You to bless me in my soul, my hearing, my sight, my spirit, my form, my character, my family, my life, my death, and my deeds — accept my good deeds — and I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise. Ameen.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي مُنكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، وَالْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْأَعْمَالِ، وَالْأَدْوَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma jannibni munkarātil-akhlāq, wal-ahwā', wal-a'māl, wal-adwā'
duas.translation: O Allah, keep me away from evil character, evil desires, evil deeds, and evil diseases.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma qanni'nī bimā razaqtanī, wa-bārik lī fīh, wa-khluf 'alayya kulla ghā'ibatin lī bi-khayr
duas.translation: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, bless me in it, and replace with good everything that is absent from me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَاسِبْنِي حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥāsibnī ḥisāban yasīrā
duas.translation: O Allah, call me to account with an easy reckoning.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma a'innā 'alā dhikrik, wa-shukrik, wa-ḥusni 'ibādatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help us to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنفُدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka īmānan lā yartadd, wa-na'īman lā yanfud, wa-murāfaqata Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa-sallama fī a'lā jannati-l-khuld
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not waver, bliss that does not run out, and companionship of Muhammad ﷺ in the highest level of the eternal Paradise.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي شَرَّ نَفْسِي، وَاعْزِمْ لِي عَلَى أَرْشَدِ أَمْرِي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَخْطَأْتُ، وَمَا عَمَدْتُ، وَمَا عَلِمْتُ، وَمَا جَهِلْتُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī sharra nafsī, wa-'zim lī 'alā arshadi amrī. Allāhumma-ghfir lī mā asrartu wa-mā a'lantu wa-mā akhṭa'tu wa-mā 'amadtu wa-mā 'alimtu wa-mā jahiltu
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from the evil of my own soul and determine for me the most upright of my affairs. O Allah, forgive me what I have hidden and what I have made public, what I have done in error and what I have done intentionally, what I knew and what I did not know.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min ghalabatid-dayn, wa-ghalabatil-'aduww, wa-shamātatil-a'dā'
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being overwhelmed by debt, from the domination of enemies, and from the gloating of enemies.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِن ضِيقِ الْمَقَامِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-hdinī wa-rzuqnī wa-'āfinī. A'ūdhu billāhi min ḍīqil-maqāmi yawmal-qiyāmah
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, provide for me, and grant me well-being. I seek refuge in Allah from the tightness of standing on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي، وَانصُرْنِي عَلَى مَن يَظْلِمُنِي، وَخُذْ مِنهُ بِثَأْرِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma matti'nī bi-sam'ī wa-baṣarī, wa-j'alhuma-l-wāritha minnī, wa-nṣurnī 'alā man yaẓlimunī, wa-khudh minhu bi-tha'rī
duas.translation: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and sight, and make them my heirs, and grant me victory over those who wrong me, and take vengeance from them on my behalf.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِيشَةً نَقِيَّةً، وَمِيتَةً سَوِيَّةً، وَمَرَدًّا غَيْرَ مُخْزٍ وَلَا فَاضِحٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ī-shatan naqiyyah, wa-mītatan sawiyyah, wa-maraddan ghayra mukhzin wa-lā fāḍiḥ
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for a pure life, a sound death, and a return that is neither disgraceful nor shameful.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا قَابِضَ لِمَا بَسَطْتَ، وَلَا بَاسِطَ لِمَا قَبَضْتَ، وَلَا هَادِيَ لِمَن أَضْلَلْتَ، وَلَا مُضِلَّ لِمَن هَدَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُقَرِّبَ لِمَا بَاعَدْتَ، وَلَا مُبَاعِدَ لِمَا قَرَّبْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ ابْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا مِن بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَرِزْقِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ النَّعِيمَ الْمُقِيمَ الَّذِي لَا يَحُولُ وَلَا يَزُولُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ النَّعِيمَ يَوْمَ الْعَيْلَةِ، وَالْأَمْنَ يَوْمَ الْخَوْفِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَائِذٌ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا وَشَرِّ مَا مَنَعْتَنَا، اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ، وَأَحْيِنَا مُسْلِمِينَ، وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ قَاتِلِ الْكَفَرَةَ الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ رُسُلَكَ، وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزَكَ وَعَذَابَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ قَاتِلِ الْكَفَرَةَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَهَ الْحَقِّ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu kulluh. Allāhumma lā qābiḍa limā basaṭt, wa-lā bāsiṭa limā qabaḍt, wa-lā hādiya liman aḍlalt, wa-lā muḍilla liman hadayt, wa-lā mu'ṭiya limā mana't, wa-lā māni'a limā a'ṭayt, wa-lā muqarriba limā bā'adt, wa-lā mubā'ida limā qarrabt. Allāhumma-bsuṭ 'alaynā min barakātika wa-raḥmatika wa-faḍlika wa-rizqik. Allāhumma innī as'alukannaim al-muqīmalladhī lā yaḥūlu wa-lā yazūl. Allāhumma innī as'alukannaīma yawmal-'aylah, wal-amna yawmal-khawf. Allāhumma innī 'ā'idhun bika min sharri mā a'ṭaytanā wa-sharri mā mana'tanā. Allāhumma ḥabbib ilayna-l-īmāna wa-zayyinahū fī qulūbinā, wa-karrih ilaynā-l-kufra wal-fusūqa wal-'iṣyān, wa-j'alnā minar-rāshidīn. Allāhumma tawaffanā muslimīn wa-aḥyinā muslimīn wa-alḥiqnā biṣ-ṣāliḥīna ghayra khazāyā wa-lā maftūnīn. Allāhumma qātilil-kafaratalladhīna yukadhdhibūna rusulak wa-yaṣuddūna 'an sabīlik, wa-j'al 'alayhim rijzaka wa-'adhābak. Allāhumma qātilil-kafaratalladhīna ūtul-kitāba ilāhal-ḥaqq
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise belongs to You. O Allah, none can withhold what You extend, none can extend what You withhold, none can guide whom You have led astray, none can lead astray whom You have guided, none can give what You have withheld, none can withhold what You have given, none can bring near what You have distanced, and none can distance what You have brought near. O Allah, spread upon us Your blessings, mercy, bounty, and provision. O Allah, I ask You for lasting bliss that does not change or cease. O Allah, I ask You for comfort on the day of need, and safety on the day of fear. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have given us and from the evil of what You have withheld from us. O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts, and make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to us, and make us among the rightly guided. O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, and keep us alive as Muslims, and join us with the righteous without disgrace or temptation. O Allah, fight the disbelievers who deny Your messengers and block Your path, and bring upon them Your punishment and torment. O Allah, fight the disbelievers among the People of the Book, O God of Truth.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-hdinī wa-'āfinī wa-rzuqnī wa-jburnī wa-rfa'nī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, provide for me, mend my condition, and raise me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنقُصْنَا، وَأَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا، وَأَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا، وَآثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا، وَأَرْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma zidnā wa-lā tanquṣnā, wa-akrimnā wa-lā tuhinnā, wa-a'ṭinā wa-lā taḥrimnā, wa-āthirnā wa-lā tu'thir 'alaynā, wa-arḍinā wa-rḍa 'annā
duas.translation: O Allah, increase us and do not decrease us, honor us and do not humiliate us, give us and do not deprive us, favor us and do not favor others over us, and make us pleased and be pleased with us.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aḥsanta khalqī fa-aḥsin khuluqī
duas.translation: O Allah, You have made my form good, so make my character good.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِي وَاجْعَلْنِي هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma thabbitnī wa-j'alnī hādiyam mahdiyyā
duas.translation: O Allah, make me firm and make me a guide who is himself guided.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنِي الْحِكْمَةَ الَّتِي مَن أُوتِيَهَا فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ātinī-l-ḥikmatallatī man ūtiyahā fa-qad ūtiya khayran kathīrā
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me wisdom, for whoever is granted it has indeed been given abundant good.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَمَن تَبِعَهُم بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim 'alā nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa-'alā ālihi wa-aṣḥābihi ajma'īn wa-man tabi'ahum bi-iḥsānin ilā yawmid-dīn
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and all his companions, and those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgment.
